summary: Activation patching of bump-only (centred Δ̃) vs full residual swap at one position, blocks {1,3,5,7,9}, 100 held-out wikitext-2 val pairs with top1_A≠top1_B and margin>2. Standard patching pattern, correct isolation via attribution ratio, clean calibration separation, proper sanity checks.
strengths: Held-out wikitext-2 validation split separated from cycle 235 train calibration
Three-forward design (clean/bump/full) correctly isolates bump contribution and normalises by full-swap magnitude
Centring Δ̃ = Δ − μ_l reuses cycle 235 features for consistency with T1/T3
Identity sanity (v_bump=x_lA → attribution≈0) and hook-restore checks are the right guards
Cache pattern (5 block hooks × 200 seqs × 3 positions) keeps compute linear; 1500 short forwards fits 2–4 min budget
Pair filter (top1 differ, both margins > 2.0) avoids degenerate denominators

concerns.desc: forward_pre_hook on h[l+1] writes args[0][:,p,:]=v; plan already flags type(args[0]) check on first call. Correct pattern for GPT2Block.
x_l cache uses forward_hook on h[l] output[0] (tensor from the (hidden_states, presents, ...) tuple). Identity sanity will catch any output-structure mismatch.
Guard |full_logit_delta|<1e-6 → null is reasonable; also track frac_full_positive (plan does) and exclude nulls from mean.
Attribution ratio is unbounded with small-positive denominators; outliers can dominate mean. Report median and frac_gt_0.15 (plan does); if median/mean disagree, prefer median for verdict call.
l=9 means patching h[10] input; valid (GPT-2 has blocks 0–11).
